justifications.healthTech.industryPlacement: Widely accepted across healthcare IT consulting, payer ops, and digital health PM tracks, though placement depends on pairing with clinical or domain experience.
justifications.healthTech.vendorDemand: Frequently listed as required or preferred at Epic/Oracle Health consulting partners, payers, and MedTech PMOs; appears in roughly a third of senior healthcare-IT PM postings.
justifications.healthTech.salaryPremium: PMI's Earning Power survey shows ~16% US salary uplift and median ~$123K, materially above bedside PT/OT compensation.
justifications.healthTech.technicalSkillDepth: Builds process and governance fluency (scope, schedule, risk, stakeholder) but minimal technical/clinical-systems depth.
justifications.healthTech.transitionFit: Strong narrative bridge for clinicians moving to PM/consulting roles, though employers still want demonstrated PM experience beyond the exam.
justifications.healthTech.efficiency: Moderate effort: 35 contact hours of education, 36 months of PM experience, ~$400-$555 exam fee, typically 3-6 months of prep.
